questions.prompt: Copper and gold gleam brightly in the merchant's dark shop.
questions.answer: Aes et aurum in tabernā obscūrā mercātōris clārē fulgent.

questions.prompt: The infant, once the warm milk had been drunk, slept in the cradle.
questions.answer: Īnfāns, lacte calidō pōtō, in cūnīs dormīvit.

questions.prompt: We admire the goodness and patience of that famous old man.
questions.answer: Illīus senis clārī bonitātem et patientiam admīrāmur.

questions.prompt: It is not right to betray friends in a time of danger.
questions.answer: Amīcōs in perīculō prōdere nefās est.

questions.prompt: Nothing pleases the tired soldier more than a long sleep.
questions.answer: Nihil fessō mīlitī magis quam longus somnus placet.

questions.prompt: The general's camp was like a huge city on the hill.
questions.answer: Castra ducis īnstar ingentis urbis in colle erant.

questions.prompt: The gods grant that it is right for us to return home safe.
questions.answer: Dī concēdunt nōbīs fās esse salvōs domum redīre.

questions.prompt: With all his strength the helmsman withstood the force of the waves.
questions.answer: Gubernātor omnibus vīribus vim flūctuum sustinuit.

questions.prompt: Without any resources the exiles begged help from the king.
questions.answer: Sine ūllīs opibus exsulēs auxilium ā rēge precātī sunt.

questions.prompt: Moved by the mother's prayers, the judge freed the young man.
questions.answer: Precibus mātris commōtus, arbiter iuvenem līberāvit.

questions.prompt: Of his own accord the brave leader offered help to the allies.
questions.answer: Suā sponte dux fortis auxilium sociīs obtulit.

questions.prompt: Rome has produced few men like Cato in our age.
questions.answer: Rōma paucōs Catōnēs nostrā aetāte genuit.

questions.prompt: The king collected bronzes and woods from every province.
questions.answer: Rēx aera et ligna ex omnī prōvinciā collēgit.

questions.prompt: At Athens the orators praised the ancient justice of the laws.
questions.answer: Athēnīs ōrātōrēs antīquam lēgum iustitiam laudāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The Alps, covered with deep snow, terrified the weary army.
questions.answer: Alpēs, altā nive tēctae, fessum exercitum terruērunt.
